title: Classroom Supports for Educators
summary: Practical accommodations to support students with DLD in learning environments.

blocks.text: Educators play a key role in creating inclusive classrooms where students with DLD can thrive without lowering academic expectations.

items: Use visual schedules alongside verbal instructions.
Pre-teach key vocabulary before introducing new topics.
Break complex instructions into smaller, manageable steps.
Provide visual and written aids to support spoken information.

blocks.text: LinguaCare supports language development. It does not diagnose. Talk to a speech-language professional for formal assessment.
